newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving up.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving up.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to rise slightly when the market reopens on Saturday after the Friday Moslem weekend, brokers said.

"The market may move upwards slightly after Thursday's correction. The market sentiment is positive because of the recent overhauling of the bourse and appointement of a new chairman," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed & Co.
Brokers said investors were expected to return after a price fall ahead of the weekend.
The DSE benchmark index lost 51.34 points or 4.14 percent to close at 1,187.84 on turnover of 91 million taka on Thursday.
